<thought>The base peak at m/z 121.0528 is likely the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ≈120.045 Da. The formula C₄H₈O₄ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 120.042 Da, which matches the observed mass within typical ESI‑MS error, making it the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
